column1: # SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
# The Elo gauntlet's anchors, built on GitHub's runners from their official
# sources at the pinned commits (tools/gauntlet/build_anchor.sh).
# Ratings: CCRL Blitz 2'+1", single-CPU entries, list of 2026-10-31
# (computerchess.org.uk/ccrl/404/); repositories, commits, licences and build
# commands checked by research agents from each project's README, LICENSE and
# build files (no engine source opened): 2026-10-31 for the first set.
# The set of 2026-11-02 (owner): Stash 19.0 and WyldChess 1.51 dropped
# (Fork scored 92-94% against them), Marvin 6.3.0 a standing anchor (no
# longer only for a run where Fork scores over about 70% against Laser 1.7).
# Topple 0.8.1 and Seawall 20250322, the first set's alternates, left
# with them: every anchor they could replace has since built on the runners.
# The set of 2026-11-08 (owner): Clover 6.1 a standing anchor (no longer only
# Altair's alternate; v6.1 tag commit and its 3639 rechecked on the CCRL
# Blitz list of 2026-11-07, KB competition.md §5, "Gauntlet reference:
# Stockfish (gap metric) and Clover 6.1 as standing anchor"), and Stockfish
# 19 a reference opponent: 400 games, outside the rating fit. Marvin 6.3.0
# and Altair 7.0.0 continuity anchors (owner, 2026-11-08): both built and
# played in runs 41465146207 and 42392526865. Arcanum 2.8, Marvin's
# alternate, removed: its build failed in both runs, and a continuity anchor
# has no alternate.
# Roles: continuity (built and played in an earlier gauntlet; a failed build
# stops the run), new (replaced by its alternate if its build fails; if that
# fails too, or it has none, the run stops), trial (the same, but if neither
# builds the run goes on without it), alternate:STEM (replaces the new or
# trial anchor STEM), reference (not an anchor: 400 games, every opening
# with both colours, kept out of Ordo's fit and reported apart as the gap
# to it, its CCRL Blitz rating for context only; tools/gauntlet/report.py;
# a failed build stops the run).
# Columns, tab-separated: name, file stem, CCRL Blitz, role, repository,
# commit, build folder, build command ("make ARGS", several run in order
# separated by "; ", or "cmake TARGET"), fallback make arguments (or -), UCI
# options for fastchess (or -).
Weiss 1.0
Monolith 2.01
Winter 0.9
Laser 1.7
# Marvin loads book.bin from its executable's folder when one is there;
# only the binary is ever kept, so its repository's res/ folder never sits
# beside it.
Marvin 6.3.0
# The anchor above Marvin (owner, 2026-11-02: about 3,550-3,650, an unrelated
# code base, GPL or MIT, official source, pinned), proposed by the research
# agent of 2026-11-02 (KB competition.md §5, "Gauntlet anchor above Marvin
# 6.3.0"; ratings from the CCRL Blitz list of 2026-10-31): Altair 7.0.0 (MIT;
# its network in the repository, trained on its own games), or Clover 6.1
# (GPL-3.0) if Altair does not build. A trial until it has built on the
# runners: neither build was tried before the first run.
# Clover 6.1 (owner, 2026-11-08) is a standing anchor in its own right: new,
# with no alternate, so a failed build stops the run (before any game: every
# anchor is built first), as a run without it would not be the owner's set.
# Not continuity: as Altair's alternate it built in the anchor job of both
# runs (41465146207, 42392526865) but has never played.
Altair 7.0.0
Clover 6.1
# The reference opponent (owner, 2026-11-08; KB competition.md §5, the
# section named above): Stockfish 19, tag sf_19 (GPL-3.0; lightweight tag on
# this commit), CCRL Blitz 3792 single-CPU on the list of 2026-11-07 (context
# only). make net fetches its default network first; whether make build
# alone would is UNVERIFIED (the build log lines naming .nnue files show it),
# and the network's file name and SHA-256 are logged by build_anchor.sh.
# Hash as Fork's (16 MB, also its documented default), one thread.
Stockfish 19
